latency_interpretation.timing: Fixed after partial artifact grading and root execution-trace inspection, before calculating aggregate arm latency comparisons. Independent artifact reviewer has not inspected arm/latency mappings. This estimator choice is not claimed to have been pre-registered.
latency_interpretation.basis: Frozen protocol requires 25% lower paired latency but leaves estimator unnamed. Require both transparent conventional summaries; this is conservative and does not lower the frozen threshold.
latency_interpretation.eligible_pairs: Same case_id and repeat, plugin and strong-skill grades both pass under the frozen rubric; all other completed or pending pairs reported separately.
latency_interpretation.summed_paired_ratio: sum(plugin_elapsed_seconds) / sum(skill_elapsed_seconds) over eligible pairs; weights longer cases more heavily
latency_interpretation.speed_gate: Both ratios <= 0.75, no more than 5 percentage points lower overall completion than skill, and plugin >=90% completion. Alternative +15 percentage point completion improvement gate remains unchanged.
latency_interpretation.coverage_gate: No final release-gate verdict until all216 planned runs are attempted and graded; quota stops remain incomplete.
latency_interpretation.limits: 24 descriptive cases, repeated3times and shared scenes; no independence or statistical significance claim.

grading: AI-assisted artifact/answer review with independent numeric checks; not human adjudication

additional_model_observation.scope: Post-launch observation; not an initial freeze. Agent-selected downloads are allowed; any first-use download time stays included in that conversation.

final_model_inventory.scope: Post-study and post-retest inventory; initial freeze preserved separately

review_errata.effect: Only a prose dimension typo. The original report already stores correct numeric dimensions. No task grade, evidence value, threshold, performance count or aggregate result is changed.

scope: Prepared CPU runtime and initially warmed default weights; agent-selected extra model downloads remain timed. Both guides preloaded; setup and agent construction excluded.
Timing includes discovery, requested handoff manifest, verification and final/follow-up responses; not Telegram receipt.
Plugin skill is also reloadable through native discovery; baseline guide is preloaded only.
Common manifest instrumentation may have unequal costs. No estimated overhead was subtracted.
Shared scenes and repeats are not independent; no statistical significance claim.
AI-assisted artifact grading with independent numeric checks; formats can reveal implementations.
During batch42, embedded metadata exposed an elapsed_seconds field. The reviewer disclosed the incidental exposure and did not use it for artifact grading; no guaranteed timing blinding is claimed.
Frozen required-file and skeleton-edge criteria are stricter than some brief natural-language prompts; failed checks are reported separately from numerical accuracy.
Corrupt-input coverage uses one 60-byte plain-text file disguised as JPEG, not a broad set of real damaged media.
Requested provider/model fixed; observed turn fields are reported separately and do not cryptographically pin a managed backend.
Later candidate fixes and targeted replays are separate; these original grades are immutable.

The study stopped after 118 completed attempts at its disk guard, following two auxiliary preflights that created disposable Hermes environments. These were removed; an administrative harness revision permits already-downloaded additional weights while verifying all initial weights and other study identity fields. Completed runs were retained without rerunning.

resource_interruption.event: Two native isolated preflights unexpectedly created temporary Hermes managed environments/cache while original study was running, then disk guard stopped after118 completed attempts.

conservative_overlap_window.basis: Preparation config mtime through completed preflight record mtime; actual bootstrap starts later. Result mtime minus reported elapsed approximates conversation start.

resource_interruption.interpretation: Preserve all original times and grades. Disclose resource contention and the interruption; report sensitivity of paired latency comparisons to excluding these pairs, never silently replace observations.

latency_sensitivity_policy.timing: Recorded before final whole-study aggregation, after root knew partial artifact grades and two overlapped run IDs.
latency_sensitivity_policy.rule: Keep the original benchmark gate unchanged. Also report median and summed paired latency ratios with whole overlapped case/repeat pairs excluded. A speed-based publication claim requires both original and sensitivity ratios <=0.75; otherwise report sensitivity and unresolved speed evidence. This adds an evidence-integrity check, not a replacement or relaxed original threshold.

latency_sensitivity.scope: Post-incident sensitivity excluding entire case/repeat pairs that overlap the disposable runtime setup. Original results, grades, times and predefined gate are unchanged.

administrative_resume.reason: Resume after disk guard; retain agent-selected additional model weights without rewriting initial inventory
administrative_resume.scope: Only the resume identity check differs. Worker prompts, budgets, ordering and grading inputs are unchanged; original study.json and plugin source remain immutable.
